description:
Introducing the ANYterrain Stabilized 4-Wheel Folding Electric Bike — all the stability and power you love about the ANYterrain, now in a shorter, more compact frame that folds down and tucks away almost anywhere.

Like the original, the folding ANYterrain rides on four wheels for rock-solid balance and traction, whether you're cruising smooth city streets or tackling rugged off-road trails. Its unique tilting front end lets the front wheels lean into corners, so you can turn sharp while staying perfectly balanced and firmly planted. No wobbling. No tipping. Just confident, stable riding every time you climb on.

What's new is the footprint. We've shortened the frame and matched all four tires at 16 inches, making this the most compact ANYterrain yet. Each tire is still a full four inches wide, so you keep plenty of rubber on the road and that same glued-to-the-ground feel — now with a lower, tighter stance that's even easier to handle. And with one tire size across all four wheels, spares and maintenance couldn't be simpler.

Then it folds. When you're done riding, the frame collapses down so you can slide it into the back of an SUV, load it into the RV, or tuck it into a closet, garage corner, or under the stairs. Take your ride camping, to the lake, or on the road — and store it without giving up half your garage.

Under the compact frame, the performance is every bit as strong. A powerful 750-watt rear-mounted motor and 20Ah battery with genuine Samsung cells carry you up to 20 mph with a range of up to 50 miles per charge. (Range varies with rider weight, terrain, and how you use the throttle.) The sturdy, substantial build keeps the bike planted to the ground for a secure, stable ride.

Stopping is just as confident. Hydraulic disc brakes on all four wheels bring the ANYterrain to a quick, safe, controlled stop every time.

Hauling gear? You've still got a big rear basket and a front basket for all your belongings. An electric horn and easy-to-reach handlebar turn signals keep you visible and safe in the bike lane or on the street — just flip your signal to let drivers and riders know which way you're headed. Need to back out of a tight spot? The reverse feature makes maneuvering effortless.

Compact enough to store anywhere, stable enough to ride anywhere. If you want an e-bike that's easy to balance, fun to ride, powerful, and now folds up and travels with you, the folding ANYterrain is for you.

Folding, compact frame — stores and travels almost anywhere

Four matched 16" x 4" tires for a low, planted, stable stance

Powerful 750-watt rear-mounted motor

20Ah battery with genuine Samsung cells — up to 20 mph, up to 50-mile range

Hydraulic disc brakes on all four wheels

Tilting front steering for safe balancing and sharp cornering

Front and rear cargo baskets

Electric horn and rear turn signals for safe turning

Reverse feature for easy maneuvering
